mapper.sql: select a.id, a.code, a.entry_date, a.accessory_year, a.supplier_id, a.size_spec, a.bulk_price, a.regular_use, a.compliant, a.notes, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, s.name as supplier_name, s.phone as supplier_phone, s.address as supplier_address, case when u.nick_name is not null and trim(u.nick_name) != '' and u.nick_name != a.create_by then concat(u.nick_name, '（', a.create_by, '）') else a.create_by end as recorder_name, coalesce(inv.stock_count, 0) as inventory_stock_count from fabric_accessory a left join fabric_accessory_supplier s on s.id = a.supplier_id left join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.del_flag = '0' left join ( select accessory_id, count(*) as stock_count from inventory_stock where del_flag='0' and accessory_id is not null group by accessory_id ) inv on inv.accessory_id=a.id
mapper.select: where a.del_flag = '0' order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc limit 6

select a.id, a.code, a.entry_date, a.accessory_year from fabric_accessory a where a.accessory_year = #{year} and a.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from fabric_accessory_image ai where ai.accessory_id = a.id ) order by a.id
select count(*) from fabric_accessory where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from fabric_accessory where accessory_year = #{year} and del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct supplier_id) from fabric_accessory where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from fabric_accessory_image ai join fabric_accessory a on a.id = ai.accessory_id where a.del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct ai.accessory_id) from fabric_accessory_image ai join fabric_accessory a on a.id = ai.accessory_id where a.del_flag = '0'
select cast(accessory_year as varchar) as name, count(*) as `value` from fabric_accessory where del_flag = '0' group by accessory_year order by accessory_year
mapper.insert: insert into fabric_accessory ( code, entry_date, accessory_year, supplier_id, size_spec, bulk_price, regular_use, compliant, notes, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{code}, #{entryDate}, #{year}, #{supplierId}, #{sizeSpec}, #{bulkPrice}, #{regularUse}, #{compliant}, #{notes}, '0', #{createBy}, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update fabric_accessory set code = #{code}, accessory_year = #{year}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, size_spec = #{sizeSpec}, bulk_price = #{bulkPrice}, regular_use = #{regularUse}, compliant = #{compliant}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select id, accessory_id, image_url, thumbnail_url, sort_order, create_time from fabric_accessory_image where accessory_id in #{accessoryId} order by accessory_id, sort_order, id
select id, name, phone, address, create_time from fabric_accessory_supplier order by name
select id, name, phone, address, create_time from fabric_accessory_supplier where id = #{id}
select id, name, phone, address, create_time from fabric_accessory_supplier where lower(name) = lower(#{name}) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fabric_accessory_supplier (name, phone, address, create_time) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update fabric_accessory_supplier set phone = case when (phone is null or trim(phone) = '') and #{phone} is not null then #{phone} else phone end, address = case when (address is null or trim(address) = '') and #{address} is not null then #{address} else address end where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fabric_accessory where supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.insert: insert into fabric_accessory_code_sequence (accessory_year, last_value) select #{year}, 0 where not exists ( select 1 from fabric_accessory_code_sequence where accessory_year = #{year} )
mapper.select: select last_value from fabric_accessory_code_sequence where accessory_year = #{year} for update
